parameters.content:
## i2 · Deep Dive
One keyword → the same core as the screener (i1) → the 3 biggest sellers + the best low-review seller are looked up one by one → Amazon's review themes become an evidence table → AI picks which complaints to build on, code writes every number. Reuses the screener's run if it is under 24 hours old.

## Search or reuse
If this keyword was saved in the last 24 h, its listings are reused: no SerpApi search, and the deep dive describes exactly the page the screener scored.

## Who gets inspected
Per product family (variations grouped), ordered by sales, then reviews, then position. Up to 4 lookups (1 SerpApi search each). A failed lookup becomes a row that says why.

## AI writes ideas, not numbers
The AI only sees theme IDs (T1, T2…). It returns IDs + short ideas without digits. Validate drops anything with unknown IDs, numbers, or built on themes customers like, and writes the evidence from the data.
